projects.title: X-Ray Hand Image Generation and Classification
projects.description: Leveraged Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) using PyTorch for X-Ray hand image generation. Trained on a dataset of 8000 images, this approach successfully synthesized high-quality, unique hand samples.
achievements: Developed a ResNet-inspired neural network to accurately classify images as either VAE-generated, GAN-generated, or real
Achieved a remarkable 96% accuracy by training on a diverse dataset combining synthetic images from classroom projects with real images
Demonstrated advanced proficiency in image classification and deep learning techniques

projects.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Turbulent Flow Simulations
projects.description: Discovered a novel Grid-Invariant AI architecture combining convolutional autoencoders and adversarial networks to simulate high-fidelity turbulent flows, achieving unprecedented grid independence and scalability.

projects.title: Advanced Collagen Fiber Orientation Analysis
projects.description: Led advanced bio-imaging analysis using sophisticated machine learning techniques to predict collagen fiber orientation with high precision and innovative data augmentation methods.
achievements: Advanced bio-imaging analysis with FFT and SVR

projects.title: Strengthening Structures against Earthquakes: Viscous Wall Dampers
projects.description: Ranked 2nd in the department among all graduation projects. Prototyped and assessed a Viscous Wall Damper system for seismic resilience, utilizing experimentation, simulation, and theoretical data.
achievements: Achieved 60% structural damage reduction in earthquakes
Implemented physical system modeling with validated COMSOL simulations
Ranked 2nd in the department among all graduation projects
Comprehensive analysis through combined experimentation and simulation

projects.title: Lunar Descent Vehicle Design with Reinforcement Learning
projects.description: Designed a lunar descent vehicle for payload transportation from lunar orbit to the moon's surface, with a focus on safety, minimizing hardware mass, and ensuring robustness under lunar conditions.
achievements: Addressed constraints in trajectory optimization using PDEs
Optimized fuel and oxidizer selection for lunar conditions
Focused on safety, efficiency, and operational effectiveness
Designed for the unique challenges of the lunar environment

projects.title: RAG Framework Development
projects.description: Designed and implemented a production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework with context-enriched vector search capabilities for enterprise document processing.

projects.title: Automated Bag Valve Mask
projects.description: Conceived an innovative automation approach for the Bag Valve Mask, integrating advanced compliance mechanisms, which resulted in a successfully tested prototype demonstrating improved efficacy and performance.
achievements: Improved efficacy and performance over manual operation

projects.title: Structural Health Monitoring of The Wing Spar
projects.description: Ranked 2nd in the department among all projects. Developed a robust K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model to anticipate crack developments in the primary spar of a training aircraft using data from ANSYS Solid/Crack Mechanics module.
achievements: Achieved 92.7% accuracy in forecasting crack occurrences
Enhanced model for predictive analysis beyond crack formations
Ranked 2nd in the department among all projects
Integrated ANSYS simulation data with machine learning

projects.title: Microrobotic Locomotion in Blood Vessels
projects.organization: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
projects.description: Conducted computational fluid dynamics simulations for biomedical micro-robots, focusing on magnetic surface microrollers in cardiovascular applications.
